note: RIVE CITY (https://rive-city-j6lc8r.uat.rive.to/) is capture-class: a Rive hosted-player deployment (rive.to UAT, ephemeral) whose whole app is one minified IIFE (_player/hosted.js — the player host/glue), plus two binary Rive scene payloads (file.riv — the city artboard — and _player/drawer.riv — the controls artboard), the player stylesheet and the favicon. §0.4 fork-over-mirror was checked on 2026-10-12: the page and its JS carry no public source-repo reference (the only outbound link is https://rive.app/ from the drawer's build button), so the mirror stands. The CDN dependency https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@rive-app/webgl2@2.x.x/rive.js stays CDN (standing vendor rule — a CDN dependency is not backfilled into the capture); it is documented here and in README.md. Derived pipeline: capture → pinned prettier 3.9.6 (module API, default options, single pass verified idempotent — never the CLI: it respects .gitignore and can silently echo its input) → readable/<served path>.pretty.js|css per captured JS/CSS file (capture root == repo root — DISK_PREFIX "" — so the served path IS the disk path and the derived layers MIRROR it: real subdirectories + served filename kept; every pretty provably NOT byte-identical to its capture source) → statement-aligned slices src/<served path>-NN.js of the IIFE BODY (the whole file is one (function(){…})() expression, so the top-level declaration boundaries are the body's statements; wrapper-open and wrapper-close lines are non-standalone and are indexed as skipped sections). Windows are ~100-140 lines — a recorded divergence from the fleet's 250-350 window, because the whole app is 496 readable lines and the larger window would yield only two slices. Every slice parses standalone under `node --input-type=module --check -` and round-trips byte-exact to its recorded readable line range through the recorded semantic rename map (rename-map.json, re-applied on every re-cut; apply -> recover -> derive -> gates). Binary payloads (file.riv, _player/drawer.riv, _player/favicon.ico) are hashed notRendered records — no pretty/slice pass. Stylesheet rule — _player/hosted.css is wholeFile. Inline <script>/<style> scan: index.html references external scripts only (the CDN rive.js and /_player/hosted.js) — zero inline content blocks, so there are no *-inline-N twins and no index-inline-map.json. src/ identifiers are semantic names from the PLAN §5 rename campaign where the bytes allow (tools/names.json -> tools/apply-names.mjs -> rename-map.json); binary .riv payloads stay hashed records. Capture bytes are untouched by everything above; re-cut with `node tools/derive.mjs` after any capture refresh. `node tools/audit.js` is the gate.
